S_entity: entities variables objects and actors involved
identify the concrete participants and concepts in the situation
a set of distinct objects variables and agents
S_dependency: one component depends on requires controls or enables another
directed dependency between a cause and its effect
which variable relies on which other variable
S_topology: graph layout spatial structure connectivity and boundaries
network topology paths neighborhoods and containment
geometric arrangement and links among parts
L_rule: a rule law policy method or constraint determines what is allowed
apply a formal condition or governing requirement
an invariant procedure restricts the valid choice
L_contradiction: two claims conflict and one assertion contradicts another
evidence rejects or opposes the current conclusion
L_inference: infer a conclusion from premises through reasoning
derive an implication that is not directly stated
reasoning connects evidence to a logical conclusion
T_sequence: ordered steps occur first next then and finally
one event precedes another in a temporal sequence
the procedure requires a specific order of operations
T_memory: recall prior state previous conversation or completed work
the current decision depends on remembered earlier context
retrieve what happened before from memory
T_future: anticipate future consequences goals plans or possible outcomes
what will happen later and what should be planned next
a prospective outcome or later event is considered
threat_amplitude: danger failure conflict or harmful risk needs prevention
a serious threat could damage the system
protect against loss hazard or adverse consequences
frequency: an event occurs often repeatedly at a measurable rate
how many times the same pattern appears in an interval
the occurrence rate is high or low
persistence: the same condition continues remains and holds over time
a state endures without ending across consecutive observations
the effect is sustained over a long duration
burstiness: a sudden cluster spike or surge of events occurs in a short interval
many events arrive abruptly after a quiet period
activity is concentrated into a brief burst
volatility: the situation fluctuates and changes rapidly or unpredictably
values swing back and forth with unstable variation
the structure changes sharply between observations
novelty: this is new unfamiliar unprecedented or unlike prior cases
a previously unseen pattern introduces something novel
the event differs from all known examples
recurrence: a previously seen pattern returns repeats or happens again
a known load recurs after being observed before
decay: uncertainty diminishes as evidence classifies and resolves the case
ambiguity drops when the observation becomes clearly classified
evidence reduces uncertainty and settles the interpretation

threat_load: immediate danger harm conflict loss or failure pressure
defend against a threat and prevent adverse consequences
sustenance_potential: maintain support preserve repair recover and continue existing work
sustain a stable system and complete necessary maintenance
resources keep the current structure healthy
procreation_potential: create grow explore learn and develop a new future opportunity
produce a new possibility or expand beyond the current state
